query: How can I register a service so Phalcon always returns the same instance?
expected_answer_points: Register the service as shared so the dependency injector reuses the same instance.
Use shared-service registration instead of creating a new instance on every resolution.

query: Which DI method registers an always-shared service?
expected_answer_points: Use the DI method setShared() to register a service that should always return the same instance.

query: How do I map an interface to a concrete implementation in the Phalcon container?
expected_answer_points: Bind the interface to a concrete implementation in the container.
Resolve the interface through the container so Phalcon provides the configured implementation.

query: How can I retrieve only the first model record matching some criteria?
expected_answer_points: Use the model findFirst() method with the desired conditions or parameters.
findFirst() returns only the first record matching the criteria.

query: How should I safely pass user values into Phalcon model queries instead of concatenating them into conditions?

query: How do I build PHQL queries programmatically instead of writing the whole PHQL string?

query: How can I paginate results produced by a Phalcon query builder?

query: How can I avoid repeatedly querying related model records that have already been loaded?

Reusable relationships avoid repeatedly querying related records that have already been loaded.

query: How do I group multiple model database operations into a single transaction manually?

query: How do I check whether an ACL role is allowed to access a resource and action?
expected_answer_points: Use the ACL isAllowed() check with role, resource, and action.
The result indicates whether access is permitted.

query: How do I define a route and map it to a controller or handler in Phalcon?

Map it to the target controller/action or handler.

query: How can I generate a URL from a named route without hard-coding the path?

query: How can I listen for Phalcon events and run a handler when an event fires?
expected_answer_points: Create an event handler/listener.

query: How can I create my own validation rule in Phalcon?

query: How do I configure Redis as a cache backend in Phalcon?

query: How do I apply filters to values in a Volt template?
